=== 1. 提取所有TranCode (改进模式) ===
======================================================================

模块数: 2

=== 所有模块 ===
  FRMC: 1 个API
  SSP-AUTH: 1 个API

  FRMC/houseassets

--- SSP-AUTH (1 APIs) ---
  SSP-AUTH/queryCommonParamList
